Shortfalls of electricity occur periodically, when drought reduces water flow.

section.question: Where does the largest part of Kenya's power come from? Also, When was Kenya Electricity Generating Company established?
section.answer:
[1] The largest share of Kenya's electricity supply comes from hydroelectric stations at dams along the upper Tana River, as well as the Turkwel Gorge Dam in the west.
